title: TCP: Support  RFC 6675 to detect SACK caused Fast Retransmissions
description:
TCP: Support RFC 6675 to detect SACK caused Fast Retransmissions

RFC 6675 suggests the total of bytes SACK'ed is as important as
the number of duplicate ACKs. It also comes with a minor
definition update of Duplication Acknowledgement.

Update the TCP Sequence Analysis classification algo to support
these criterias:

- any ACK packet containing new SACK data is marked as being a
Duplicate ACK, even when the cumulative ACK is increasing

- any Duplicate ACK SACK'ing data of at least 3 MSS is
considered equal to 3 Duplicate ACKs.

Unexpected cases such as Keep-Alive ACK with SACK data, aren't
marked as DUP ACKs.

The following display filters might help identifying the client
behaviors :

'tcp.analysis.acks_frame && tcp.analysis.duplicate_ack
 && tcp.options.sack &&!tcp.options.sack.dsack'

Finds all Duplicate ACKs which also increase the cumulative
ACK, as a result of this implementation based on RFC 6675.
Some data was delivered to the client but at
the same time also, some new data is being SACK'ed.

'tcp.analysis.acks_frame && !tcp.analysis.duplicate_ack
 && tcp.options.sack &&!tcp.options.sack.dsack'

Finds all non Duplicate ACKs which increase the
cumulative ACK and there is no new data being SACK'ed.
Some data was delivered to the client, and that's all.

'tcp.analysis.acks_frame && tcp.options.sack
 &&!tcp.options.sack.dsack'

Finds all ACKs which increase the cumulative ACK and have SACK
data, independently of being duplicate ACKs or not.
Covers both filters above.

Fix #20529

Ping #17596

notes.body:
In case someone is testing:

rfc6675proof capture file shows packet 808 is an _Out-of-Order_ with the current classification algo, while it should be a _Fast Retransmission_ according to RFC 6675 (as a consequence of p807 being a _Dup ACK_ with much data SACK'ed)

[rfc6675proof.pcapng](/uploads/7e39dcac9800151ebfb58a27efbd23bf/rfc6675proof.pcapng)

Similarly, rfc6675proof2 show packet 4106 as an ordinary _ACK_ while it should be a _Dup ACK_ following that RFC.

[rfc6675proof2.pcapng](/uploads/bb1caf47322d0e65cf30156e9b320f0f/rfc6675proof2.pcapng)

@@ -563,7 +563,7 @@ Set when all of the following are true:
 * This is not a keepalive packet.
 * In the forward direction, the segment size is greater than zero or the SYN or FIN is set.
 * The next expected sequence number is greater than the current sequence number.
-* We have at least two duplicate ACKs in the reverse direction.
+* We have at least two duplicate ACKs in the reverse direction, or more than 2 MSS have been jumped over
 * The current sequence number equals the next expected acknowledgment number.
